websiteHeaderMenuText: Journal of thoughts, ideas and life experiences.

contents.value: Hello I am Aniket and I use to be a software engineer, currently I am on a long career break because of a back injury, and hopefully soon I will be a software engineer again.

Before getting injured I used to love going outdoors, travelling, running and doing other healthy human stuff, I had big plans for my life but at the moment almost everything is on hold. I have not given up on my dreams, but my main plan for the moment is to get rid of this life disabling, mind fucking, soul sucking pain that I have involuntarily acquired.

If you have come this far while exploring my blog, I would absolutely love it if you could just scroll down to the bottom of this page, click on that email button and drop me an hi electronically. I know it is kind of old school, but hey, old stuff can be fun!
